plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/22673
Template Malware-ext-Ransomware-databreach used (external Organized crime / Financial, Ransomware, Software installation, Obscuration, data_disclosure Yes, 4-step chain). Interruption added per the ransomware rule.
Deviations: discovery coded Unknown instead of Actor disclosure, because the notice says the company 'detected' the attack and no leak-site claim or ransom note detail was found. Asset S - File (a server holding historical personnel files) instead of S - Unknown. The ransomware group was not named; Organized crime / Financial are template defaults for ransomware.
Data: names, addresses, DOB, SSNs, bank account numbers, I-9 documents (driver's licence, passport, permanent resident card), beneficiary information. Coded Personal and Bank, data_victim Employee. Count: 622 Massachusetts and 23 New Hampshire residents per state filings; the overall total was not disclosed, so no data_total.
Timeline: detected September 16, 2025; intrusion start not given, so the detection date is the incident date. dbir_year 2026.
INDUSTRY NEEDS REVIEW: the issue carries the NAICS 22 label and 'naics 221', but Form Energy develops and manufactures batteries (energy storage systems) and is not a utility. Coded NAICS 335910 (battery manufacturing). Change back to 221 if you want it counted with utilities.
Victim: Form Energy, Somerville, Massachusetts. Employee count roughly 800-900 (LinkedIn/company profile, approximate) -> 101 to 1000.
Confidence Medium: law-firm and claims-site sources only, no ransomware group or method.

summary: Form Energy, Inc., a developer and manufacturer of long-duration iron-air battery energy storage systems, detected a ransomware attack on September 16, 2025. Forensic analysis found that a server containing historical personnel files was accessed, exposing current and former employees' and beneficiaries' names, addresses, dates of birth, Social Security numbers, bank account numbers and I-9 identity documents. Notification letters went out October 22, 2025; filings list 622 Massachusetts and 23 New Hampshire residents. No ransomware group was named.
